notes: INFO: No typos fixed. Title tag, the heading Our Services and all ten service cards (title, description, duration, price, button text) are character for character the live Wix text, in the live Wix order. Kids’ Haircut keeps the curly apostrophe Wix uses.

INFO: The meta description was changed on purpose on 2 November 2026, so it is no longer the live Wix text. Online booking was dropped that day. The salon owner wants clients to use the salon's own booking, so there is no online booking link, and the Book Now buttons call 347-671-5095. The live Wix description was "Book hair and makeup appointments online with HairByGerta in Staten Island, NY. Reserve haircuts, color, balayage, keratin treatments, Brazilian blowouts and makeup in minutes." The new one is "Call or text to book hair and makeup appointments with Gerta in Staten Island, NY. Haircuts, color, balayage, keratin treatments, Brazilian blowouts and makeup." This change is on the fixed list of intended differences in qa/check_content.py.
INFO: No heading on the live page gets its capitals from styling (textTransform is none for every text), so every heading is stored as Wix writes it.
INFO: Live Wix prints Call for price twice in each card. The first copy is a 1 px label for screen readers only. It is stored once, in price.

INFO: button_label is the text of the button in every card. On live Wix the photo, the title and the Book Now button of a card all link to a Wix Bookings page for that service. Those pages are not part of this site. Here only the button is a link, and it calls the phone number. No online booking link is planned, because clients book through the salon's own booking.

INFO: closing_note_html is not on the live Wix page. Until 9 November 2026 it was the closing line of the first version of this site (Prefer to book by phone or text? Call 347-671-5095, ...). Since online booking was dropped, every booking goes by phone, so the line now says so: To book, call or text 347-671-5095, Tuesday to Saturday, 9 AM to 5 PM. The phone number is a tel link.

INFO: All ten card photos are placeholders, so alt is empty for each. Live Wix also gives all ten an empty alt, and so did the first version of this page, so there is no old alt text for these slots. alt_original holds, for reference only, the description the first version gave the same photo file on its Gallery page (the same text as in the gallery content file). svc-haircut and svc-bridal are used on this page only and have no description in either source, so their alt_original is empty.
INFO: Each card photo is shown 290 x 195 px. Wix crops the photo to fill that box (object-fit cover).

ASK: none. The earlier question was what the photo foils-highlights (Highlights & Lowlights card) shows. Version 1, first version of this site: Stylist finishing a blowout with hairspray (Gallery page) and Stylist finishing a blowout in the salon (Home page). Version 2, live Wix About page, alt text on the same Wix media file (37eb08_e3724fb50274487ab7afa56767278d97~mv2.jpg): Applying blonde highlights with foils to a client’s long hair in the salon. The reference screenshots of the live Gallery and About pages answer it: the photo shows a stylist using hairspray on a finished style, with no foils. So alt_original keeps version 1, the same as the gallery content file, and the Wix alt text of version 2 does not describe this photo. Nothing shown on the page depends on it. The one question left for the owner on this subject is which photo belongs in the top right box of the About page, see the ASK in content/about.json.
